author: FreshImmuc
name: YTAudio
short: Music via yt-dlp: YouTube, Spotify links, SoundCloud and more.
description: Replacement for Red's Audio cog that plays through yt-dlp and FFmpeg instead of Lavalink. yt-dlp is installed into the cog's data folder on first load and updated daily.
install_msg: Unload Red's Audio cog first (`[p]unload audio`), then `[p]load ytaudio`. Needs FFmpeg on the host. If PyNaCl/davey were installed just now, restart the bot once. yt-dlp installs itself on first load (takes about a minute).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server music settings and saved playlists, including the user ID of each playlist's creator.
